headline: Rare Earth Equities Lag Despite Supply Constraints and Government Price Floors
summary: Western rare earth equities have dropped year-to-date even as China maintains export control, Washington mandates a $110/kg price floor for NdPr, and heavy rare earth prices surge.
why: Rare earth elements are critical materials for high-performance magnets used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, and defense equipment.

impacts.name: Rare Earth Mining
impacts.why: Mining equity valuations have failed to track spot market price premia due to operational and commercial hurdles.
